mentions.name: Mobile-efficient unlabeled mask segmentation model
mentions.description: This project develops a visual model architecture for unlabeled mask segmentation designed to run efficiently on mobile phone hardware; it is currently in the evaluation stage with promising early results.
mentions.source_excerpt: Currently running some small evaluations on an idea around unlabeled mask segmentation that will run efficiently on mobile phone hardware.
